title: Some Issues
text:
Some Issues. This has the potential to be a 5 star item it just falls a little short.

Pros:

Comfortable
Nice cover
Seems well made for the most part.

Cons:
The item I got will not fold completely flat. The headrest is stuck kind of folded over and no matter how I follw the instructions I can't get it loose.
This is very narrow. Only acceptable for a child, thin teenager or smallish woman. A full sized male or bigger woman is going to hang out on either side of this. Also not for very tall people.
The back is kind of sturdy without any support behind it, but it doesn't seem like it will stay in place for very long.
There is also a center of gravity issue with this. If you don't sit in it just right it rolls back and falls over which is dangerous. I was trying this out on a hard surface floor to see if it would move or stay in place, and it flipped me straight back into the coffee table.

Close, but no cigar folks.
